extraction: VizieR ASU TSV export, -out=**&-out.max=unlimited. Cleaned file maps upstream columns to a standard schema (id,ra_deg,dec_deg,z,z_err,q_flag,member_flag) and appends sep_arcmin and R_proj_Mpc computed from the cluster centre with FlatLambdaCDM(H0=70,Om0=0.3). No rows dropped. Where the upstream redshift is stored as a velocity cz in km/s it is converted to z=cz/c and its uncertainty is converted consistently to dz=e_cz/c; otherwise no values are altered. Raw upstream response kept verbatim in raw/.
note: Abell 2744 (z=0.308). Boschin, Girardi, Spolaor & Barrena 2006, A&A 449, 461 ('Radial velocities in A2744'). 102 galaxies with heliocentric radial velocities. Redshift is stored upstream as HRV in km/s and is converted to z=HRV/c in the cleaned file. MEMBERSHIP: column n_Seq flags NON-members with '*'; a blank means member. The member_flag column in the cleaned file preserves this verbatim, and n_members_published_definition counts the blank (member) rows. Instrument: ESO NTT/EMMI plus literature (Couch & Newell cross-identifications in column CN). Selection function: small, targeted, magnitude-limited sample - too small on its own for a sigma(R) field; included because Owers+2011 incorporates it and because it provides an independent velocity zero-point check. Note coordinates are sexagesimal upstream and were converted to decimal degrees.
